result.description: Nebula Forge CF-210 is a fictional compact network appliance for edge routing and small-office packet filtering. It features dual 2.5GbE ports, a fanless aluminum chassis, and a low-power embedded ARM platform designed for always-on use. Suitable for branch networking, lab segmentation, and lightweight VPN termination.
result.title: Nebula Forge CF-210 Compact Network Appliance
